headline: Arcnights surges back into ARC-2 gold at 11th

sections.text: Arcnights added 15.42 points to reach 64.17, rising from 17th to 11th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board and moving back into the 15 gold places.
The gold cutoff rose 5.97 in the past day to 55.00; Kajetan Schweighofer is 16th at 54.44, 0.56 short.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
